name: Dockkeep Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed self-hosted backup manager with a web UI and headless scheduler for Restic backups and Rclone syncs; supports cron schedules, retention, restore browsing and email/Pushover notifications, with no published software quota.
watch_out: Requires your own amd64 Docker host, backup disks or separately billed remote storage, and configuration of Restic credentials. No built-in web UI authentication: expose only on a trusted network or behind VPN/authenticated proxy. ARM images are not provided; independent production reliability is not verified.
